title: viewer_desktop.open_app
description: Open a registered Viewer app in a new window. Params: { appId: string (e.g. 'mesh','lanes','gaps','terminal','calculator'), title?: string }. Returns { ok: true, appId, windowId }; an unknown appId returns { ok: false, appId, error, available: string[] } carrying the live registry ids (not a deny) so the caller can resolve and retry.
